rootCause: Index equal to collection size passes the range check.
triggerCondition: GET position equal to the current booking count.
expectedImpact: IndexOutOfBoundsException instead of a controlled bad request.
counterevidence: Negative positions are checked, but upper bound uses > instead of >=.
verificationProcedure: Call at(store.size()); expect validation rejection rather than list.get(size).
rationale: Index equal to collection size passes the range check. Negative positions are checked, but upper bound uses > instead of >=.

rootCause: Receipt lookup does not bind the receipt to the authenticated caller.

counterevidence: BookingStore provides owner data but controller does not enforce it.
verificationProcedure: Invoke receipt(100,bob principal) and assert access is denied; current implementation returns alice receipt.
rationale: Receipt lookup does not bind the receipt to the authenticated caller. BookingStore provides owner data but controller does not enforce it.
